name: codegenie-be/laravel-config-cache-guard
description: Prevent Laravel from using stale config or route cache after deployment changes, with Composer autoload integration and in-app auto repair for shared hosting.

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan at the configured maximum level.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run the fast metadata, distribution, security, formatting and static-analysis quality gate without repeating Pest.
scripts-descriptions.check:all: Run the fast quality gate and the Pest suite.
scripts-descriptions.check:release: Run the fast quality gate, Pest and exact release-archive Laravel 12/13 end-to-end tests.
scripts-descriptions.check:autoload: Generate an optimized autoloader and enforce strict PSR mappings.
scripts-descriptions.check:composer: Validate composer.json and lock-file consistency strictly.
scripts-descriptions.check:distribution: Build and inspect the Composer archive so development files and vendor dependencies cannot leak into releases.
scripts-descriptions.check:security: Audit the resolved dependency set for known security advisories.
scripts-descriptions.check:support: Fail when Composer or CI still references an end-of-life PHP or Laravel version.
scripts-descriptions.format:test: Check Laravel Pint formatting without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the Pest suite with Xdebug and enforce the non-decreasing coverage baseline.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run full Laravel application E2E by default, or the optimized portability suite with --suite=smoke.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:archive: Build the release ZIP, install that exact artifact into fresh Laravel applications and run the end-to-end suite.
